method.physical_lines: len(raw_bytes.splitlines()) exactly as existing builder; binary artifacts retain raw splitline metric but are not code savings
method.code_lines: Exact isolated code_count AST function, excludes docstrings/comments/layout; Python files under src/tests/scripts only, exactly as existing builder invocation
method.non_counted_categories: docs/history, ordinary docs, artifacts, examples and other files report code_lines=0 (not applicable under this metric), not proof of zero embedded code
method.tracked_rule: Immutable Git tree blobs for fixed refs. Current ls-files paths read working-tree bytes, including tracked staged/unstaged changes; missing tracked files listed/excluded, all untracked files excluded.
method.tree_hash: SHA256 sorted JSON path->rawSHA256, UTF-8, compact separators
